prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On a clear afternoon in Pasadena, Texas, Driver 1 was changing lanes on a multi-lane roadway when the vehicle's right side made contact with the left side of Driver 2's vehicle, which was travelling alongside in the adjacent lane. Both drivers stopped at the scene and remained with their vehicles. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which I found consistent with the direction and force of the sideswipe. Driver 2 stated that the lane change was made without a signal and that the contact occurred as Driver 1 moved over. Two independent witnesses in nearby vehicles gave statements that matched this account. Scene photographs show damage concentrated along the right side of Driver 1's vehicle and the left rear of Driver 2's vehicle, which fits the reported impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy. Driver 1 said no prior damage had occurred to the vehicle, and no earlier damage was observed during the inspection. A passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, but it is not fully clear from the statements which seat that person occupied at the moment of impact. No citations were issued at the scene, and both parties were advised to exchange insurance information before leaving.
